summary.text: David Nelson is the Republican candidate for Oklahoma House of Representatives District 16 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Rosie Lynch in a race with no incumbent.

paragraphs.text: Nelson advanced from the Republican primary for District 16 without appearing on the ballot after the June 16, 2026 primary was canceled.
He previously ran in the 2025 special Republican primary for Oklahoma State Senate District 8, finishing second with 31.6 percent of the vote on March 4, 2025.
Nelson then lost the April 1, 2025 special Republican primary runoff to Bryan Logan, 55.6 percent to 44.4 percent.
